Get the average area and edge length of H3 hexagons

Source: R/h3_metrics.R
ddbh3_get_hexagon_avg.Rd

Get the average area or the average edge length of H3 hexagons at one or more resolutions

Usage

ddbh3_get_hexagon_area_avg(resolution = 8, unit = "m^2", conn = NULL)

ddbh3_get_hexagon_edge_length_avg(resolution = 8, unit = "m", conn = NULL)

Arguments

resolution

A vector of integers between 0 and 15 with the H3 resolutions

unit

Character. Unit of the result. For ddbh3_get_hexagon_area_avg(), one of "m^2" (default) or "km^2". For ddbh3_get_hexagon_edge_length_avg(), one of "m" (default) or "km".

conn

A connection object to a DuckDB database. If NULL, the function runs on a temporary DuckDB database.

Value

A numeric vector with one value per element of resolution

Details

These functions do not take H3 cells as input; they return a constant per resolution. To get the exact area of a cell or the length of a directed edge, use ddbh3_get_area() or ddbh3_get_edge_length().

They also work inside dplyr::mutate() with a column of resolutions.

Examples

## Load needed packages
library(duckh3)
library(dplyr)

## Setup the default connection with h3 and spatial extensions
## This is a mandatory step to use duckh3 functions
ddbh3_default_conn(threads = 1)

## Average hexagon area at resolution 8, in km2
ddbh3_get_hexagon_area_avg(8, unit = "km^2")
#> [1] 0.7373276

## Average edge length at all resolutions
ddbh3_get_hexagon_edge_length_avg(0:15)
#>  [1] 1.281256e+06 4.830568e+05 1.825130e+05 6.897922e+04 2.607176e+04
#>  [6] 9.854091e+03 3.724533e+03 1.406476e+03 5.314140e+02 2.007861e+02
#> [11] 7.586378e+01 2.866390e+01 1.083019e+01 4.092010e+00 1.546100e+00
#> [16] 5.841686e-01

## Inside mutate
points_tbl <- read.csv(
  system.file("extdata/example_pts.csv", package = "duckh3")
) |>
  ddbh3_lonlat_to_h3(resolution = 8)

points_tbl |>
  mutate(
    area = ddbh3_get_area(h3string),
    area_avg = ddbh3_get_hexagon_area_avg(ddbh3_get_resolution(h3string))
  )
